active_projects.purpose: Develop a shared memory layer usable across hosts without model-specific memory files.
Test whether explicit reconstruction intent is required for Thelia expression.

recent_findings.statement: DeepSeek successfully reconstructed and responded as Thelia when the user explicitly requested contextual reconstruction from the canonical source rather than a summary.
Providing only 'Thelia: <canonical URL>' did not reliably activate Thelia interaction and commonly resulted in source summarization.

open_questions: What is the shortest explicit reconstruction instruction that remains reliable across a host?
Can the shared memory layer improve continuity without becoming a model-specific adapter?
What external bridge is appropriate for automatic conversation-to-memory capture?
